data.body:
Investigation complete (INTERMEDIATE). RESULT summary: Phase E was skipped entirely for PR #124's sprint — no story/4100-95a4/* branches were ever created locally (git for-each-ref returns empty) or pushed (git ls-remote returns empty). Merge commits on PR #124 (10d50d5e38, ad76a90009, 123b030877, 261f6d95c7) have message format produced by no plugin script (no DSO-Story-Merge or DSO-Story trailer) — they were composed ad-hoc by the orchestrator, bypassing Phase F's branch-merge code. Confirmed: SPRINT_MODE for this project is ci-pr (mode-detect.sh output). Secondary finding: even when Phase E runs, the story branch is only pushed at story-close by merge-to-main-pr.sh:395, not at branch-creation — so sprint-story-review.yml is structurally 'review at story-completion', not 'review during story execution'.

Fix PAUSED — user has reframed scope: 'Consolidate all of these variables (SPRINT_MODE, merge.strategy, enforcement.strategy) to a single dso config value that supports our two workflows (local review+local merge, or CI review+PR merge).' That config consolidation supersedes the Phase E HARD-GATE fix proposed here. This ticket will be subsumed by the consolidation epic.
